review_text: To list all of my complaints would make this post way too long so I will list a few. Verizon is a master at bait and switch. As an example, I had discovered that the hot spot that connected directly to my phone with ATT was very expensive to use and asked what their hotspot was like. The salesman said, “this device is so much better, you will love it!” and, it was FREE with the purchase of...well, I agreed to the required gadget, along with new phones that I had planned to buy. (The plan was to use the hotspot device at my office where I had no phone service, I was assured that this could replace the need for a WiFi connection at work. Pretty cool, huh? I trusted him to know and I followed his assurance that I would be much happier, I purchased one hotspot for me and one for hubby. I also purchased a boatload of stuff that they said I needed, or didn’t know that I wanted, and would only cost small amounts or free with my purchases. Again, cool! At checkout, they took me to an electronic device to sign for my purchases. I was presented with a copy of the contract, tucked inside my purchases and I was on my way outta get to know my new phones. Got home, read the signed contract and found out that EACH item received, free or discounted, came with a large, unreasonable, fee to establish the account (service fee) ANDin addition to this hook up fee, the “free” hot spots required $20 per month for use PER device! Yep, I was paying more than $50 and an extra $40 per month for my free and really great new hotspot service! Okay, as long as I was getting WiFi for my internet service at work, it was worth it, I thought. However, I discovered that not only was I required to carry this hotspot device with me, I had to dial the number to activate it whe I used it. This was anything BUT better than my ATT hotspot! I contacted verizon to say I wanted to return and discontinue the hotspot service and was told I would owe an early disconnect fee PLUS over $300 on EACH device, because I had signed up for 2 years. Remember that this was touted as a much better option to the hotspot included in my ATT account; but I could not get internet service on them where I needed it! Totally worthless device and program and I was stuck paying $40 per month for two hotspots with a device that never was taken from the box after I tried to make it work, because using it increased the fee even further. Yes, I was stupid to not ask more questions or demanding to read the contract before signing, but the salesman really took advantage of my trust and technical innocence to grab himself a hefty paycheck, I am sure! So much more to this but, trust me, he never cared about helping me, he just wanted to pad the bill. I am sure that they all had a huge laugh at my expense, heck, I would have laughed had I not been so terribly misled! After 3 years of paying Verizon almost $200 a month, I am finally happy to be switching to another provider and putting their unconscionable business practice behind me! If I could, I would set up a booth in front of this store and warn everyone entering about how their tricks and false/misleading promises making them sign an unread contract to bind them to a long, expensive and unwanted service contract. Beware!
notes: went sarcasm because they said stuff like 'pretty cool', although the review itself is long and negative throughout so it is not dominated by sarcasm

I did have a budget, but mentioned if I absolutely loved something, I would spend more. I worked with Amanda. It's interesting how little of a selection the store has? I wanted form fitted and a good amount of beading. I told her I really liked crepe, but wasn't limiting my choices to only that material. Not one of the dresses brought for me to try on had close to a generous amount of beading on them. I'm not totally sure Amanda really understood what I was looking for, because she kept bringing me a few dresses at a time that were not anything close to what I had asked for. No one in the store was overly friendly and the whole appointment was kind of awkward. I liked Berta and was interested in a gown they were expected to get in their Spring 18 line. Amanda said she would get back to me asap about pricing and information on that gown since I didn't really find anything I loved at the store. It's been over 1 month and no email, no call. I don't think the associates care or are even remotely interested in any of the brides that walk in. They don't listen to them, they don't give input on what might look best. They just make the whole experience super awkward as if they don't really want you trying on the gowns unless you know you are going to purchase it. It was all kind of a big joke. If you want a real salon with amazing designers, amazing associates.. go to Mira Couture down the street! I found both of my gowns there!

Horrendously Disappointed I heard such good things about CRI and was super excited to learn about my ancestry. I started my journey with CRI with enthusiasm and patience, and by the time I was done I was disappointed, underwhelmed, and felt ripped off. Let’s start from the beginning. When I originally attempted to sign up there was an offer for 70% off. My browser refreshed after I entered my email, and it wouldn’t let me access the discount again. The website was prompting me to pay the full amount. So, I reached out to support. They were kind enough to help me resolve that issue. Continuing on, I was placing my order. I selected the Ancestry+health. I received a prompt that contained additional offers such as the halplogroup readings. I selected that I was interested in the maternal Halplogroup reading, which was 80 dollars and the expedited processing that guaranteed my results within 3weeks which was around 30. I did so tentatively, thinking I could review my order before purchase. LITTLE DID I KNOW THEY CHARGED MY CARD FOR EACH INDIVIDUAL THING FOR SIMPLY SELECTING THAT I WAS INTERESTED. Again I reached out and explained that I did not want the Halplogroup reading because it was out of my price range. They offered me a discount, which I appreciate, and I decided to keep the extra reading. That wasn’t too bad but we’re not done. After my order shipped I received a notice that my kit was on back order, and I wouldn’t receive it for two weeks. Why would they offer expedited services that I could purchase if they couldn’t deliver said expedited services? I figured it may have been an error. So again, I reached out. Support was helpful and sent the kit out. They also guaranteed I would receive my results within 3 weeks of their receiving my kit. I received my kit around the 20th of October 2019. When I went online to register it, the site did not recognize the kit number. So AGAIN I had to contact support. It took a day before it was updated so I could register it. I sent my kit out after that, and waited excitedly for my results. Except it wasn’t 3 weeks. By the end of November I still had no results (about five weeks later). So I reached out again, and there was some confusion because they thought I had already been refunded because of the discount. When all was done they refunded me the 30 for the expedited processing. I did not receive my ancestry results until mid December 2019. I was happy with the ancestry portion, it was very interesting. But the Halplogroup reading does not tell you much at all, and is NOT WORTH THE COST, especially since it only tells you one side of your lineage. In addition all of my health and trait results state Inconclusive to this day (January 2nd 2020). Which wouldn’t be a big deal if I didn’t pay about double the price specifically to have these results. Supposedly they are “investigating” this, and have been for two weeks now. I started out excited to know more about my family, and I was truly optimistic. I am a patient person and was grateful when they tried to resolve the issues but there was literally an issue every step of the way with this company. I was planning on getting my boyfriend an ancestry kit as a gift but it sure won’t be through CRI Geneticss.

Maybe the engine compartment of my dad's 72 Chevy. If you enjoy walking on low pile carpet with absolutely no padding, you'll love the rooms here. Would you like a bed with no box spring and just a metal frame with springs? Gotcha covered. You know how freshly laundered sheets feel crisp? Well don't worry about that here. They feel nice and broken in, just waiting for you to jump in. ( Now you know why I bring my own hostel sheet and blanket ) Do you like listening to others people's dogs bark all afternoon and into the night? You're in luck, the place is full of them. How about rooms that claim to be non smoking, yet you can clearly smell incense burning, which we all know is used to mask the odor of other combustible items.. check that box! There's a full kitchen, that's right. But alas, there are no utensils, plates, cups, pots, pans, glasses or knives. Wanna know how to obtain such things? Pay $30 and it's yours. Oh, no coffee maker, iron or blow dryer. But there are towels. No additional fee here. For now. Don't think about blowing your nose. You won't find tissues around here. Just some super awesome, single ply toilet paper guaranteed to irritate your nose. The fridge had a hard time staying cold, know why? Because the door open sensor is going out and the light stays on all the time. I know because the seal around the door was off and I can see the light creeping through. I should just leave my GatorAde on the counter next time. Far cooler than a box with an 80 watt light a foot away. The desk chairs are straight out of a corporate break room. No cushion, just lovely hard plastic. I don't watch TV, so I have no idea if it worked or the channels it contained. There was a remote, but no guide to be found. The AC unit made sound, which was great as that helped to drown out the barking dogs. But did it keep the room cold? Sorta. Well, it was better than sleeping outside on the hood of my car. So, Mr. Whiny Reviewer, why did you stay here? Second chances. I stayed at the same chain in Beaumont and had a bad experience. So I thought that maybe the hotel sucked because Beaumont sucks. Nope. It's a chain thing. I was hoping it to be an isolated incident. But alas, I was wrong. It's just sad that for an additional $20, you could stay at a Marriott variant of the same hotel style and get a totally enjoyable experience. With breakfast and dinner that includes free beer and wine! And a lobby that doesn't feel like the Salle Port in a jail. Oh, and a kitchen with stuff in it. The kind of stuff that will allow you to cook your own food. No additional fee. TL:DR version 1/10, will not stay again. And don't bother to post the carbon copy 'thanks for the feedback, let us try to earn your business' line, Mr Woodspring Hotel. Anyone reading these reviews can see there are better options out there. Like sleeping in a rest stop off 45 North with your windows rolled down and your wallet taped to your forehead. I hope you enjoyed this review more than I enjoyed staying here. Later.

Everything started off good. Joey was our sales rep. I should of known when he asked me if I could make Decisions or if my husband needed to be home was an indication. He gave us a quote, little higher than others- but was going on this was the best quality out there with best customer service. We ordered 23 windows. My husband came home during the meeting and was concerned about the plantation shutters we had put in- Joey assured us numerous times they would be fine. We had a big discussion over the back door in the playroom (again with matching shutters.) To make a long story short... the shutters did not fit the door. We did not want to spend another $900 on shutters just for the door... and have an mismatching issue.- this is why we astressed this issue. The door did not work- Joey said we never talked about it and still needed to pay for it. We ordered 23 large windows, spent thousands of dollars and he is arguing over a door. It could of easy been resolved if he did not start out the conversation with ,”We never discussed this.” The product is fine- there are better ones out there and we did overpay looking back. The best part of this experience was the hard working installers. Nick and his crew were amazing, hardworking, on time and just good people. He went above and beyond on everything- just sad Joey could not follow up and do the same with customer service. The end result was we ended up paying for the door. He gave us a minimal credit, and a bunch of BS. Make sure you get everything itemized. We asked several times and he would not give us an itemized statement - just a price.. We wanted to know how much each window was and what we were paying for. We never received any individual cost, which makes it easy when it comes to a “discount” on the door that did not work. The “discount” was not the retail amount they charged us in everything else- appears to be the cost so Joey would not have it come out of his commission. My advice is to keep everything simple and written out, so you know exactly what you are paying for. Joey’s best friend is the owner- so talking to management was a waste. Please buy LOCAL, it’s easier to maintain honest, customer service. We made a big mistake.
